PROJECT TITLE
Enhancing Maternal and Child Health for Tribal Communities in Madhya Pradesh

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Sehat Rural Health Network seeks funding to significantly improve critical maternal and child healthcare access for underserved tribal communities in Madhya Pradesh. Our project will deploy mobile clinics, conduct health awareness camps, and provide telemedicine support to address significant health disparities and reduce preventable maternal and child mortality. We aim to reach thousands of beneficiaries, fostering healthier futures and empowering communities through improved health outcomes.

PROBLEM & NEED
Tribal communities in remote areas of Madhya Pradesh face severe barriers to accessing essential maternal and child healthcare, including geographical isolation, lack of infrastructure, and limited awareness. This results in high rates of preventable maternal and infant mortality, malnutrition, and poor health outcomes, perpetuating a cycle of vulnerability and hindering community development.

APPROACH & ACTIVITIES
*   Deploy fully equipped mobile health clinics to provide antenatal, postnatal, and pediatric care directly in remote tribal villages.
*   Conduct regular health awareness camps focusing on nutrition, hygiene, safe delivery practices, and immunization schedules.
*   Establish telemedicine support systems to connect community health workers and patients with specialist doctors for consultations and referrals.
*   Train local community health volunteers to ensure sustained engagement and basic health support within their villages.

EXPECTED IMPACT
This project will significantly improve health outcomes for tribal women and children by increasing access to timely, quality care. We anticipate a reduction in maternal and infant mortality rates, improved nutritional status, and enhanced health literacy within target communities. The initiative will empower communities to take charge of their health, fostering long-term well-being and resilience.

BUDGET SUMMARY
We seek funding within the range of INR 20 lakh to INR 75 lakh. This budget will cover the operational costs of mobile clinics, procurement of essential medical supplies, organization of health camps, development of telemedicine infrastructure, and training of local health personnel, ensuring efficient and impactful project delivery.

CONCLUSION
Sehat Rural Health Network is committed to transforming healthcare access for Madhya Pradesh's most vulnerable populations. With your support, we can create a lasting positive impact on maternal and child health, building stronger, healthier tribal communities. We welcome further discussion on this vital initiative.
